name: title healing: a node whose statement runs thirty words gets a display title of six words or fewer within a round (M68)

seed.content: The raised beds along the south fence should be rebuilt in cedar at forty centimetres high with a drip line under the mulch so the tomatoes and peppers get steady water through the hot weeks of July and August.

rounds.user: Also plan a small herb spiral by the kitchen door for thyme, sage and rosemary.
rounds.assistant: Herb spiral by the kitchen door: thyme, sage, rosemary.
